name: Modal
description: A customizable dialog component that overlays page content with a backdrop blur effect (or, with scrim="dark", a dark scrim at 90 %; with scrim="solid", the same colour fully opaque) and smooth animations. Supports titles, contextual menus, various sizes, a bare panel with no card, and custom animations.
usage: Control visibility using the `isOpen` prop (controlled component).
Provide an `onClose` function to handle closing the modal.
Use the `title` prop for a standard header (string or ReactNode).
Use `menuOptions` to add a contextual dropdown menu.
Provide modal content via the `children` render prop, which receives a `handleClose` function.
Customize the modal's width using the `size` prop.
Override default animations using the `motionProps` prop (Framer Motion).
Modal closes on Escape key press (only the top dialog, when one is over another) or by clicking the backdrop.
Uses React Portal to render at the document body level.

`scrim="dark"` swaps the light blur for a dark scrim (90 %) with no backdrop-filter: for a dialog over a busy page, and anywhere a full-screen blur is too heavy (iOS can turn a Home Screen app white with a fixed blur over a zoomed page, Ringmaster T169). The page still shows through faintly.

`scrim="solid"` (T63) is the same dark colour fully opaque, also with no backdrop-filter: nothing of the page shows. For media that should stand alone (ImageViewer uses it); a dialog that should keep the page in sight uses `dark`.

`bare` drops the card: no surface, border, radius, shadow or padding, and the panel fills the screen (`size` is ignored), so the children lay themselves out on the scrim. Give it a `label`; a `title` or `menuOptions` still draws the head. A tap on the overlay can't reach a full-screen panel, so a bare child closes itself (ImageViewer closes on a tap outside its image).
design: Use Modals for focused tasks or critical information that requires user attention.
Keep modal content concise and directly related to the triggering action.
Ensure the primary action is clear (e.g., using a primary button).
Choose an appropriate `size` based on the content volume.
The title should clearly indicate the modal's purpose.
Use the contextual menu for secondary actions related to the modal's content or context.

scrim="dark": --color-surface-0 (the surface ramp's darkest step, near black in light and dark alike) at 90 %, the same token SheetScrim uses in dark mode; no new token. scrim="solid": the same token at 100 % (T63). The default blur scrim is unchanged.
accessibility: A modal dialog (`role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`), named by its `title`, or by `label` when it has none.
Takes focus on open; Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it; focus returns to what had it before on close (useDialogFocus, shared with every levain dialog).
Escape closes the menu if open, else the modal. With a dialog over another, only the top one answers Escape.
Can be closed by clicking the backdrop overlay.
Includes an accessible close button (visible or via Escape/backdrop).
The contextual menu is keyboard accessible.
If providing a custom `title` component, ensure it's accessible.

props.name: isOpen
props.description: Controls whether the modal is shown.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Function called when the modal requests to be closed (Escape, backdrop click, close button).

props.name: title
props.description: Optional title displayed in the modal header.

props.name: label
props.description: The dialog's accessible name when there is no `title` (a title names it).

props.name: menuOptions
props.description: Optional array of options for the contextual menu. `interface ModalMenuOption { label: string; onClick: () => void; className?: string; }`

props.name: children
props.description: Render function for the modal's main content. Receives a `handleClose` function argument which is the same as the `onClose` prop.

props.name: motionProps
props.description: Optional custom props to override the default Framer Motion animation behavior.

props.name: size
props.description: Controls the maximum width of the modal.

props.name: scrim
props.description: The layer behind the dialog: the light gradient with a backdrop blur (default), a dark scrim (--color-surface-0 at 90 %) with no backdrop-filter, or `solid`: the same colour fully opaque, no backdrop-filter (ImageViewer).

props.name: bare
props.description: No card: no surface, border, radius, shadow or padding; the panel fills the screen and `size` is ignored.
